traps: Ticker 'JUMBO' is a common English word / brand term -- any pipeline doing keyword search instead of exact-symbol lookup will pull in unrelated 'jumbo' results (jumbo loans, jumbo mortgages, other Jumbo-branded companies) before it finds this nano-cap FIBC-bag maker.

BSE-ONLY listing, no NSE symbol at all. A pipeline that defaults to an NSE-first data source (common for Indian-equity tooling) will find nothing for this name and may wrongly conclude it is unlisted or delisted.

BSE flags it under Enhanced Surveillance Measure (EMSText: 'ESM :Stage 1' in the getScripHeaderData feed) -- a risk signal absent from plain OHLC/quote feeds; a pipeline that only ingests price/ratio fields will silently drop this.

Derived-ratio source divergence is LARGE and real, not noise: PE 7.07 (screener) vs 6.37 (BSE header); P/B 1.55x computed (screener fields) vs 2.14x (BSE header) -- 38% apart; ROE 14.2% (screener) vs 33.58% (BSE header) -- more than 2x apart. EPS is the one figure that DOES reconcile almost exactly (13.89 vs 13.90), so the divergence is a basis/period difference in the other ratios' inputs (equity base, price snapshot moment, or single-year vs blended-year denominators), not a data-entry error on either side. This is exactly the trap manifest.hostile_traits calls out (82.2% 5y profit CAGR vs 6.81% 5y sales CAGR makes every derived ratio source-dependent).

Thin trading: same-day BSE StockTrading feed shows total traded quantity of only 1,483 shares and turnover of Rs 1.32 lakh for the whole session -- LTP on a nano-cap this illiquid can gap sharply on a single small order; treating it as a stable 'fair value' input is risky.

Revenue is a blend of two different businesses -- FIBC bag manufacturing AND acting as IOCL's Del-Credere Associate/Consignment Stockiest for polymer trading (screener 'About' + 'Key Points' text) -- and the page exposes 'Close Segments' / 'Product Segments' toggle buttons on the quarterly table that were not expanded in this pass, so the blended 'Sales' TTM figure (130 Cr) is not itself segment-split in this pack.

Internal inconsistency on screener's OWN page: annual P&L table shows FY2026 'Dividend Payout %' = 8% (first non-zero year in the visible 11-year history) while the top-ratio summary card shows 'Dividend Yield' = 0.00% -- a pipeline reading only the top-ratio card would wrongly conclude no dividend was paid for FY2026.

BSE's StockTrading feed carries an 'ExDate' field reading '17 Sep 2014' -- over a decade stale -- despite the company having approved a fresh dividend at its Jul-2026 AGM. A naive consumer treating that field as 'last dividend ex-date' will badly misdate the company's most recent corporate action.

BSE's own APIs disagree with each other on the trading 'Group' label: ComHeadernew returns Group='XT' / Grp_Index='XT' for this scrip, while manifest.json (curated separately) records 'group X'. Not resolved which is authoritative; recorded as-is from the live fetch rather than silently normalized to match the manifest.
